deterministic_candidate_selection.existing_witness_skip_key: (decision_id, joint) across old and supplemental witness files
deterministic_candidate_selection.rule: one lower-median teacher_audit candidate per parent_seed/interface/joint/original_feasible group after tick, numeric uid, decision_id, source sort

selected_teacher_audit_groups.rule: one plan per selected o2m/m2i group and six plans per selected i2f group

scope.candidate_feasibility_source: recorded teacher_audit entries in each annotation-referenced label file
scope.coverage_limit: Feasibility and reason counts are read from recorded teacher_audit entries; no new query or witness_state call was made.
